name: nlopt-6e6593f1-blind24
instr:
# NLopt gives wrong optima, instant failures and crashes across its solvers — diagnosing without a test suite

The repository has received 24 separate undocumented edits. I use this library to minimize my own functions, and almost nothing I ask of it comes back right. My objectives, the bounds I set and the way I call them are all unchanged from before. Most runs do not finish at all: I ask for a relative tolerance on the variables together with an evaluation budget, hand in a smooth unconstrained objective, and the process dies with a memory fault within the first handful of evaluations, whichever method I pick. Asking the library to turn a method's printed name back into its numeric identifier hands me a different method than the one I named, so the value I get does not round-trip to the name I passed in.

When I ask for one of the deterministic searches that work by repeatedly cutting the bounding box into smaller pieces, the value that comes back sits far above the known minimum of the bounded objective I gave it, and the trail of evaluations shows it choosing which region to cut next by something unrelated to how good that region is. The variants of that family that re-order the sampled values before deciding where to cut are worse still: they pick their next region almost at random and finish nowhere near the solution. Longer runs of these same searches, long enough that pending regions begin being discarded as well as added, come back with a worse answer than short run
